title: Efficient generation of site-specific point mutations in cell lines by hyper active CBEs (hyCBEs)
protocol: Take 15 μl of the upstream Oligo.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Take 15 μl of the downstream Oligo.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting.
Denature at 95°C for 5 minutes.
Allow to cool slowly to room temperature.
Dilute samples 100-fold for subsequent use.
Amplify U6-sgRNA scaffold for SpCas9 from PX458 plasmid.
Clone amplified U6-sgRNA into pcDNA 3.1(+) eGFP plasmid.
Incubate reaction mixture at 37°C for 20 minutes.
Add 10× FastDigest Green Buffer to the reaction mixture.
Add Fast Digest BbsI to the reaction mixture.
Add plasmid vector to the reaction mixture.
Add ddH2O to reach a total volume of 20 μl.
Perform agarose gel electrophoresis after digestion reaction.
Add 400 μl of Binding Solution to the centrifuge tube at 55°C until melted.
Invert the tube a few times to accelerate melting.
Add 200 μl CBS (Equilibration solution) to the adsorption column.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 1 minute and discard waste liquid.
Transfer melted gel to an adsorption column at room temperature.
Incubate for 2 minutes and centrifuge at 6000 rpm for 1 minute.
Add 500 μL of wash solution to the adsorption column.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 1 minute, then pour off the waste liquid in the collection tube.
Repeat step by adding another 500 μL of wash solution and centrifuging again.
Put the adsorption column back into the collection tube, then centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 2 minutes.
Dry the Wash Solution from the column using a hairdryer for about 30 seconds.
Transfer the adsorption column to a new 1.5 ml centrifuge tube.
Add 20 μL of pre-heated ddH2O to the adsorption membrane at room temperature and incubate for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 2 minutes, with the bottom liquid containing the recovery product.
Mix the BbsI-linearized U6-sgRNA(sp)-EF1α-GFP vector with the annealed product in a ratio of 1:3.
Add 1 μL of T4 Buffer to the mixture.
Pipette 1 μL of T4 DNA ligase into the solution.
Add ddH2O up to a total volume of 20 μL.
Incubate the ligation system in a water bath at 16°C for 30 minutes.
Add 7.5 mM sterile NaOH to achieve a concentration of 1.25 mg/ml.
Mix the product with 30 μL DH5α competent cells by pipetting and keep on ice for 10 minutes.
Heat shock at 42 °C for 90 seconds, then return to ice for 5 minutes.
Add 500 μl LB liquid medium without antibiotics.
Resuscitate at 37 °C for 40 minutes.
Centrifuge at 3000 rpm for 1 minute and remove 400 ul of the medium.
Spread evenly on corresponding resistant LB plates and culture for 12-16 hours.
Pick a single colony and cultivate in the corresponding resistant LB liquid medium on a shaker at 37 °C for 12-16 hours.
Add 500 μl BL buffer to the adsorption column, centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 1 minute, and discard the waste liquid.
Transfer overnight cultured bacterial solution to a 2 ml centrifuge tube, centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 1 minute, and discard the supernatant.
Add 250 μl P1 solution to the centrifuge tube, use a vortex shaker to mix thoroughly, add 250 μl P2 solution, gently invert 6-8 times, add 350 μl of P3 solution, and invert 6-8 times again.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 10 minutes.
Add the centrifuged supernatant to the adsorption column and centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 1 minute.
Add 600 μl of PW buffer to the adsorption column.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 1 minute.
Pour off the waste liquid in the collection tube.
Repeat once.
Put the adsorption column back into the collection tube.
Spin at 12000 rpm for 2 minutes.
Open the cover and blow with a hairdryer for about 30 seconds to completely remove the PW buffer.
Transfer the adsorption column to a 1.5mL centrifuge tube.
Add 50 μl pre-heated 55 °C ddH2O to the middle of the adsorption membrane.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 minutes.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 2 minutes.
Take part of the plasmid solution and send it to the company for sequencing.
Compare the sequencing results, leaving the correct sequencing expressing plasmid-U6-sg-EF1α-GFP.
Enzymatically digest BE4max vector X μl.
Pipette Rad51-DBD fragment Y μl into the mixture.
Add Codon-optimized Apobec3A/Apobec3A(N57G) Z μl to the reaction.
Mix 5×CE MultiS Buffer 4 μl with the solution.
Incubate Exnase MultiS 2 μl in the reaction mix.
Add ddH2O up to a total volume of 20 μl.
Incubate the mixture in a water bath at 37 ℃ for 30 minutes.
Seed HEK293T cells into 24-well plates to achieve approximately 80% confluency on the next day.
Transfect the cells with 750 ng of hyBE4max/BE4max and 250 ng of sgRNA expression plasmids using polyethyleneimine following the manufacturer’s protocol.
Harvest the cells three days after transfection for genomic DNA extraction.
Transfer cultured mammalian cells (up to 10^5) to a sterile 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 12000rpm for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant completely.
Add 200 μl of Buffer GA to the resuspended cells and fully shake and mix using a vortex shaker.
Add 20ul Proteinase K and mix well.
Add 200ul of Buffer GB, fully shake and mix.
Incubate at 70°C for 10 minutes.
Add 200ul Absolute ethanol and vortex for 15 seconds.
Centrifuge briefly to remove water droplets from the tube wall.
Transfer the supernatant to a Spin columns CB3 and centrifuge at 12000rpm for 30 sec.
Remove the supernatant completely.
Add 500ul GD buffer to the Spin columns CB3, centrifuge at 12000rpm for 30 sec, remove the supernatant completely.
Add 600ul PW buffer to the Spin columns CB3, centrifuge at 12000rpm for 30 sec, remove the supernatant completely.
Repeat step of adding 600ul PW buffer and centrifuging at 12000rpm for 30 sec until all supernatant is removed.
Centrifuge at 12000rpm for 30 sec to ensure removal of any remaining supernatant.
Discard the supernatant completely and air-dry the Spin columns CB3 for several minutes.
Transfer the columns to a 1.5ml centrifuge tube, add 18-30 μl of TE buffer or distilled water.
Incubate at 55°C for 10-20 minutes to dissolve the DNA.
Centrifuge at 12000 rpm for 2 minutes.
Plate 6 x 10^6 HEK293T cells in 10 ml DMEM containing 10% FBS on a 10 cm plate 12 -18 hours before transfection.
Preheat the appropriate amount of cell culture medium for 15 minutes in a 37 °C water bath in advance.
Prepare transfection mixes in separate 50 mL tubes.
Vortex each mix well and incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Combine A and B mixes, vortex thoroughly, and incubate for an additional 20 minutes at room temperature.
Add the solution 1 ml to the 10 cm cells plate carefully.
Incubate in a CO2 incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 6-8 hours.
Replace the transfected cell medium with 12 ml fresh DMEM containing 10% FBS and 1% P/S of transfected cells.
Incubate cells in a CO2 incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2 for 48 hours after transfection.
Collect the supernatant of HEK293T cells after 48 hours transfection.
Centrifuge the conditioned medium at 8000 rpm in a tabletop centrifuge for 10 minutes at 4 °C to pellet cellular debris.
Filter the supernatants through 0.45 μm filters to remove small particle debris.
Add 26 ml of each viral supernatant to ultracentrifuge tubes.
Centrifuge at 25000 rpm, 4 °C for 2.5 hours.
Check if firm combination is implemented for safety consideration.
Make sure the canisters are balanced to prevent an uneven high-speed spin.
After centrifugation, carefully decant the supernatant into a beaker with bleach inside the tissue culture hood.
Use a vacuum to dry the remaining liquid on the walls of the tube without touching the bottom of the tube.
Add 500-1000 μl of 1xPBS or less to resuspend the pellet by vigorous triturating.
Transfer the supernatant(s) to new tubes and centrifuge at top speed in a microcentrifuge for ten minutes at 4°C.
Use the virus immediately or aliquot viral supernatant into cryotubes as 30-50 μL aliquots and store at -80 °C.
Plate 1X10^4 HEK293T cells per well in DMEM containing 10% FBS in a 96-well plate at 37 °C, 5% CO2 incubator for 12-16 hours before titration.
Infect the cells when they reach approximately 40% confluency.
Make 10-fold gradient dilutions in 1.5ml EP tubes for 6 consecutive dilutions and make 3 holes per gradient (3 wells should be control plate without virus).
Thaw virus on ice from -80°C storage.
Add 90 μl complete medium plus polybrene (8 µg/µl) to each tube.
Add 10 μl of the virus stock solution to the first tube and mix.
Mix 10 μl of the mixed virus into the second tube.
Repeat mixing step in parallel five times, creating a series of dilutions.
Infect cells with 10, 1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001, 0.0001 μl of viral supernatant in wells of a 96-well plate.
Incubate the infected cells overnight at 37°C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Aspirate virus-containing culture medium from wells approximately 24 hours after infection.
Gently add 100 μl of complete culture medium to each well to facilitate cell growth.
Count number of cells before loading Calibur flow cytometry three days post-infection.
Analyze fluorescence expression via Fortessa Flow Cell Analyzer (BD).
Resuspend sample wells by about 300 μl after centrifuging the cells.
Select wells with a fluorescence ratio between 1-20% for calculation following Flowjo analysis.
Infect 2 × 10^5 HUDEP-2(ΔGγ) cells in a 48-well plate with Lenti 117G-hyA3A-BE4max-P2A-GFP and Lenti 117G-hyeA3A-BE4max-P2A-GFP lentiviruses in the presence of polybrene (8 µg/µl) at an MOI = 40.
Calculate the volume of virus added based on the formula provided.
Add 250 μl total cell culture medium for 48 well.
Mix 50 μl virus with 0.25 μl polybrene and 200 μl complete cell culture medium to infect HUDEP-2(ΔGγ) cells.
Maintain and expand HUDEP-2(ΔGγ) cells in serum-free expansion medium (SFEM).
Supplement SFEM with human Stem Cell Factor (SCF, 50 ng/ml), Erythropoietin (EPO, 3 IU/ml), dexamethasone (DEX, 1 μM), and doxycycline (DOX, 1 μg/ml).
Add 2% Pen/Strep to the medium.
Culture HUDEP-2(ΔGγ) cells in an incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO2.
Sort approximately 1000-2000 successfully infected cells for a fluorescence marker after 3 days post-infection.
Add complete cell medium with 2% P/S and plate sorted cells to 96-well plates.
Continue to expand the culture of sorted HUDEP-2(ΔGγ) cells.
Harvest at least 8x10^4 HUDEP-2(ΔGγ) cells for genomic DNA extraction between day 10-15 post-infection.
Extract genomic DNA using Blood/cell/tissue DNA Isolation Kit.
Amplify the DNA fragment containing the target 117G through PCR.
Use HBG-Δ G γ-117G-F(Merlin) and HBG-Δ G γ-117G-R(Merlin) primers for amplification.
Roughly confirm the amplified product by Sanger sequencing using KOD–Plus-Neo DNA Polymerase.
Perform high-throughput deep sequencing to obtain precise editing efficiency with site-specific primers 117G-Hitom-F/R, which contain an adaptor sequence at the 5′ end.
Subject the above products to a second-round PCR.
Mix the resulting libraries and sequence them on an Illumina HiSeq platform.
